// Not compiled: handed to `common::portability::gnu_gate_sites` as text.

#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
#[test]
fn a_linux_gate_over_a_glibc_claim() {
    assert!(info.needed.iter().any(|name| name == "libc.so.6"));
}

#[cfg(all(target_os = "linux", target_env = "gnu"))]
#[test]
fn a_gnu_gate_over_the_same_claim() {
    let floor = info.glibc_max.expect("a gnu binary has a floor");
}

#[cfg(all(
    target_os = "linux",
    target_env = "gnu"
))]
#[test]
fn a_gnu_gate_wrapped_over_four_lines() {
    assert!(info.interp.unwrap().contains("ld-linux"));
}

#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
#[test]
fn a_linux_gate_over_a_claim_no_libc_decides() {
    assert!(info.pie, "a cargo test binary is a PIE");
}

#[test]
fn an_ungated_test_that_makes_a_glibc_claim() {
    assert_eq!(info.glibc_max, Some("2.9".to_owned()));
}

#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
#[test]
fn a_claim_that_lives_only_in_a_comment() {
    // libc.so.6 and its glibc_max are what a gnu host would show here
    assert!(info.class == 64);
}

#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
#[test]
fn a_second_linux_gate_over_a_loader_claim() {
    assert!(interp.contains("ld-linux"), "the dynamic loader");
}
